cli_install.intro: Use the bundled CLI, build it locally, or set U_WORKERS_CLI_PATH to your local binary. Put the multica executable on PATH before starting the daemon.

skip.title: Welcome to U Workers!
skip.subtitle: We've added one issue to help you connect a runtime. When it's ready, start with Siman from Runtimes.
skip.error_body: The runtime guide didn't get created. You can try again, or connect a runtime from the Runtimes page whenever you're ready.

install_runtime.title: Connect a runtime
install_runtime.subtitle: Install Codex or Kimi, then start the guided Siman chat from Runtimes.

step_workspace.lede_first: A workspace is where your issues, agents, and projects live. You can invite teammates or spin up more workspaces later.
step_workspace.lede_resume: Resume setup with the workspace you already have, or create a new one alongside it — you can belong to any number of workspaces.
step_workspace.name_placeholder: Acme Inc, My Lab, Side Projects…
step_workspace.issue_prefix_suffix: . You can change this later in settings.
step_workspace.issue_prefix_pending: Set the URL above and issue numbers will follow it — or type a prefix here.
step_workspace.hint_name_first: Name your workspace to create it.
step_workspace.hint_pick: Pick your workspace or start a new one.
step_workspace.slug_format_error: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
step_workspace.slug_taken_error: That workspace URL is already taken.
step_workspace.slug_reserved_error: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_headline: Ask your administrator for an invitation.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede: This U Workers instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Once an administrator invites you to a workspace, accept the invitation and refresh to continue.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede_resume: Workspace creation is disabled on this instance, so you'll continue into your existing workspace.

step_runtime.scanning_lede_prefix: Your agent works through an AI coding tool you already have — like
step_runtime.scanning_lede_suffix: , and others. We're checking this computer for ones you've installed.
step_runtime.empty_headline: No agent runtime found on this computer yet.
step_runtime.empty_lede_prefix: An agent runtime is an AI coding tool we connect to — like
step_runtime.empty_lede_suffix: . Install one and refresh, or pick a path below.
step_runtime.empty_skip_subtitle: Agents can't run until a runtime is connected.
step_runtime.hint_pick: Pick an agent runtime above to start with Siman.

mika_intro.headline: Meet Siman, your first agent teammate.
mika_intro.name: Siman
mika_intro.blurb: Tell Siman what you want done. It becomes an issue, with the right agent on it.

task.title: Start your first task
task.connected: Siman will help turn your goal into a task using the selected runtime and model.
task.no_runtime: Open your workspace and create a task. You can connect a runtime later.
